messages:
Samir Khan: hey folks, day2 question 1) who owns the model-eval infra (the hosts that run the nightly evals) and 2) who I should ask to get added to the dedicated compute quota for experiments?
Lila Gomez: welcome Samir! model-eval infra is under eng-ml. Carol owns the eval pipelines.
Samir Khan: thanks Lila 1) any direct contact for Carol? 2) if I need more quota, is that eng-ml or eng-platform?
Tom Baker: hey Samir, +1 from eng-platform here. quota requests that affect billing or cluster sizing go to eng-platform. small dev quota bumps can be handled by eng-ml directly.
Samir Khan: cool. what does a "small bump" look like?
Carol Park: hi Samir 1) small bump = <=2 additional r5g nodes or gpu quota under 4xA100. anything larger needs a ticket to eng-platform with cost owner cc.
Samir Khan: got it. is there a template? don't want to miss required fields.
Lila Gomez: use the "Infra: Project & Service Access" template on the infra board. include: project_id, estimated hours/week, cost_center, experiment label, and owner.
Samir Khan: perfect. and for pager access to eval alerts, who manages that?
Tom Baker: PagerDuty policy is managed by eng-oncall but eng-ml owns the alert rules. @Eng-Platform Bot can add you once Carol confirms.
Eng-Platform Bot: automation: to add to PagerDuty, file an infra ticket with "PagerDuty: add user" and include your SSO email and project tags.
Samir Khan: thanks. last thing 1) my SSO hasn't provisioned access to the internal dataset bucket (403 when trying to list). who does dataset permissions?
Carol Park: dataset access is handled by data-platform (cc @IT Helpdesk for manual grants). we'll need the dataset name + reason + duration.
Samir Khan: dataset name is `eval-models-prod-embeddings`, reason: onboarding experiments for thesis-repro. duration: 30 days to start.
IT Helpdesk: IT ticket advice: use the "Data Access Request" template and attach a signed DPA if accessing PII. Expect 1-2 business days.
Samir Khan: thanks everyone. I'll file the two infra tickets (quota + pager add) and the data request. will post links when done.
Lila Gomez: FYI, if you want faster interim access for small reads, Carol can grant a presigned URL or temporary role for a day.
Samir Khan: that's helpful 1) filing now.
Samir Khan: (update) filed infra tickets: TICKET-6842 (quota bump) and TICKET-6843 (pager add), and DATA-2105 for dataset access. attaching links: https://tickets.redwood/TICKET-6842
Carol Park: ack, I'll review DATA-2105 and eng-ml will approve small quota if needed.
Tom Baker: noted; putting TICKET-6842 on the eng-platform queue.
Samir Khan: appreciate the warp-speed responses. closing thread once access is confirmed :smile:
